title: Savior, Like a Shepherd Lead Us
input: Savior Like a Shepherd Lead us

candidates.title: Savior Like a Shepherd Lead Us (with lyrics) - Beautiful Hymn

lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Savior, like a shepherd lead us
Much we need thy tender care
In thy pleasant pastures feed us
For our use thy folds prepare

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: We are thine, do thou befriend us
Be the guardian of our way
Keep thy flock from sin, defend us
Seek us when we go astray

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Early let us seek thy favor
Early let us do thy will
Blessed Lord and only Savior
With thy love our bosoms fill

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are
Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus
Thou hast bought us, Thine we are

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: Blessed Jesus, Blessed Jesus
Thou hast bought us
Thine we are

candidates.notes: Used transcript wording for the line "With thy love our bosoms fill" which differs from the reference's "our beings fill". All other lines follow the reference wording.
